neighbours.label: the start of a second, unit-converted version of a measurement or range given in parentheses ('(between 6 and 18 mph)', '(25.4 x 30.5 cm)')
fire: The hikers climbed between 900 and 1,200 meters a day (between 3,000 and 4,000 feet).
The print measures 8 x 10 in. (20.3 x 25.4 cm) without the frame.
Daily highs reach 30 to 35 degrees Celsius (between 86 and 95 degrees Fahrenheit).
The fish grows to 40 inches long (about 100 centimeters) in the wild.
Tickets cost 20 to 30 pounds (between 25 and 38 dollars) at the door.
The trail is 12 miles long (roughly 19 kilometers) from end to end.
Each bag weighs 50 to 60 pounds (between 23 and 27 kilograms).
The desk is 48 x 24 inches (122 x 61 cm) and made of oak.
quiet: The hikers climbed between 900 and 1,200 meters a day in the summer.
The print measures 8 x 10 inches without the frame.
Daily highs reach 30 to 35 degrees in July and August.
The fish grows to 40 inches long in the wild.
Tickets cost 20 to 30 pounds at the door on Friday.
The trail is 12 miles long and very steep near the top.
Each bag weighs 50 to 60 pounds when it is full.
The desk is 48 inches wide and made of solid oak.

notes: Top examples: '(between 18 and 45 miles', '(819 mm x 648 mm)', '(entre US$17 millones'. Probes: 'between' opening a converted range 0.84-0.90, '(25.4 x 30.5 cm)' 0.54, '(about 9 to 18 euros)' 0.84; a plain '2 m x 1 m' or '12 by 8 inches' without a conversion stays near 0.
